findings.issue: Several Copa del Rey 1st-leg rows for small, unrelated Spanish clubs render the real Atlético Madrid crest (the famous red/white striped shield) or the Sporting CP laurel crest as their row icon, purely because the club's own name contains the word 'Atlético' or 'Sporting'. Seen on: 'CD Baztán at Atlético Calatayud', 'Atlético Melilla at Atlético Pinatarense', 'Atlético Unión Güímar at Sporting Hortaleza', and 'Sporting de Alcázar at CP Talayuela' (torsdag/lørdag/søndag rows). None of these clubs are Atlético Madrid or Sporting CP, so the crest actively misidentifies who is playing -- worse than the honest blank/sport-glyph fallback shown on the other Copa del Rey rows (e.g. 'Anaitasuna - CD Tedeón', 'Ribadesella - SD Noja') that have no crest match.

Same wrong-crest issue reproduces at the 900px width: 'Atlético Calatayud - CD Baztán' and 'Atlético Pinatarense - Atlético Melilla' both show the Atlético Madrid crest; 'CP Talayuela - Sporting de Alcázar' shows the Sporting CP crest.

notes: No horizontal overflow or clipping at any of the three widths (375/393/900) -- checked both the full-page captures and per-viewport scroll segments; the 375px shot (hardest case) scrolls cleanly with no cut-off text.
All visible streaming channels are Norwegian: Viaplay, TV 2 Play, Eurosport / HBO Max, HBO Max (Sport), Chess.com/TV. No FOX/ESPN/Sky or other foreign broadcaster seen.

The floating 'Assistent' button never occludes the last agenda/news row or the footer at any width checked -- at 900px it sits in the empty right margin; at 375px it rests over mid-list rows only, per the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom (WP-146 variant D). Not flagged.
Norway matches (Norge - Danmark, Norge - Portugal) render correctly with flag, correct Norwegian TV 2 Play channel, and the must-see accent dot -- no truncation of either side of the fixture.
Footer (Oppdatert-dato, kalender-abonnement, Aktivitet/Personvern links, data-freshness line, AI-budsjett line) is intact and unclipped at both 375px and 900px.
Header, day headings, and the Uka/Nyheter toggle all render intact and aligned at every width.

Observed but not flagged as a layout bug (out of this review's scope -- a coverage/content call, not a rendering one): the agenda for 24.-27. september carries roughly a dozen near-identical Copa del Rey 1st-leg rows for very small Spanish clubs, several with no known streaming ('-'). Still a single quiet column with generous spacing, so no calm-design violation, but the sheer repetition is worth a second look from whoever curates Copa del Rey coverage depth.
Did not interact with the Uka/Nyheter toggle or open any detail sheet/modal -- only the default 'Uka' view was captured and judged, per the prompt's screenshot-only steps.
Dark mode was not captured this run (default light/system scheme only).
